note: v479: Record a paycheck straight from a deposit. Tap ⋯ on a payday deposit → Paycheck → pick which payday it is, and the amount is saved to the Budget tab and matched to the bank line in one step. Paychecks you've recorded now reconcile like everything else instead of sitting unmatched. If a paycheck lands in an account you don't reconcile here, set it aside with the eye-off button or tag it to the right bank.
